title: Free week of Claude giveaway
summary: My Claude subscription came with 3 one-week guest passes: one for me, one for a friend and one for a viewer. To enter, you fed a dog, a cow or any animal, took a photo and sent it to me as a DM. No link, no comments, no follow.
notes: This was a one-time giveaway from the reel. The first genuine photo won.
No link or payment was ever needed to enter. Ignore anyone asking for one in my name.
